issues_identified_in_original.title: Missing defensive checks for _changes
issues_identified_in_original.description: after_commit() does not check for existence or type of session._changes, leading to AttributeError or TypeError

issues_identified_in_original.title: _changes not cleared between transactions
issues_identified_in_original.description: Residual _changes from previous transactions can leak into subsequent transactions

issues_identified_in_original.title: Shared mutable state on global session
issues_identified_in_original.description: Attaching _changes directly to db.session is not thread-safe and violates session isolation

issues_identified_in_original.title: Non-atomic index updates under concurrency
issues_identified_in_original.description: Multiple threads can interleave index updates, causing race conditions and data loss

issues_identified_in_original.title: Incomplete test coverage
issues_identified_in_original.description: Original tests do not cover missing _changes, rollback, or proper isolation scenarios

issues_identified_in_original.title: Improper event binding mechanism
issues_identified_in_original.description: Uses db.event.listen(db.session) binding to global instance instead of Session class

threading_lock.description: Added threading.RLock for atomic index updates
threading_lock.impact: Prevents race conditions in concurrent index operations (fixes Issue 4)

session_info_storage.impact: session.info is transaction-scoped and thread-safe (fixes Issues 2 & 3)

defensive_checks.description: Added existence and type checks in after_commit()
defensive_checks.impact: Prevents AttributeError/TypeError from missing or invalid state (fixes Issue 1)

state_cleanup.description: Clear searchable_changes after commit and on rollback

rollback_handler.impact: Ensures clean state after rollback (fixes Issue 2)

session_binding.impact: Uses recommended SQLAlchemy pattern, better isolation (fixes Issue 6)

test_coverage.defensive_checks: TestDefensiveChecks - Missing changes, type errors, isolation
